proposal: The Mandate recommends that HRSA use notice-and-comment rulemaking to update the women's preventive services mandate; rescind its contracts with the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists and set up a Federal Advisory Committee Act compliant advisory committee; include fertility awareness-based methods and supplies; remove male condoms; and remove ulipristal (Ella) from the contraceptive mandate (pp. 484 to 485).
remaining: Notice-and-comment rulemaking to repromulgate the women's preventive services mandate (none found; the 2025 to 2026 cervical screening update used a Federal Register comment notice, not a rule; p. 484)
Rescission of the ACOG-linked cooperative agreements and a FACA-compliant advisory committee (none found; guidelines still developed through the Women's Preventive Services Initiative; p. 484)
Express coverage of fertility awareness-based method supplies (the guideline includes instruction in these methods but supplies were not found; p. 485)
Removal of condoms from the guidelines (still listed; p. 485)
Removal of ulipristal from the contraceptive mandate (still listed; p. 485)

status_summary: No rulemaking, advisory committee change or revision of the contraception guideline was found. HRSA's guidelines page (last reviewed December 2025) lists one update in the period, a cervical cancer screening change put out for comment in the Federal Register on 2025-10-01 and finalized in a notice published 2026-01-05, developed through the Women's Preventive Services Initiative under HRSA cooperative agreements. The contraception guideline still references the December 2021 FDA Birth Control Guide, which lists condoms and ulipristal acetate. The Supreme Court decided Kennedy v. Braidwood Management on 2025-06-27, upholding the Secretary's appointment of Task Force members, without addressing HRSA recommendations.
title: Repromulgate the women's preventive services mandate; revise the contraceptive guidelines
uncertainties: No rulemaking, advisory committee change or revision of the HRSA contraception guideline was found. The HRSA guidelines page (last reviewed December 2025) still lists condoms and ulipristal acetate and lists fertility awareness instruction without supplies; whether the Women's Preventive Services Initiative agreements still run through ACOG was not checked. Introduced bills run toward wider contraceptive access and none is enacted. The 2025-08-13 vacatur of the exemption rules is tracked in c14-57. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
